note: Recast from the revision by Constantino (1995), the original in English. The soldier and the large worker are described; measurements of the male alate holotype (mm): head length 3.10, head width without the eyes 3.45, fontanelle length 0.52, pronotum length 2.50, pronotum width 4.25, hind tibia length 6.50, maximum eye diameter 1.23, ocellus length 0.45; ratio of eye diameter to head width 0.36, ratio of ocellus length to head width 0.13. Broken OCR numbers ("3,10", "(i.50") have been corrected from context.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: The alate is distinguished by its large size and very large eyes; the most similar alates are S. grandis and S. magnoculus. The most similar soldier is S. wheeleri, which has larger marginal teeth on both mandibles, placed nearer the tip.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head capsule short, head length and width subequal, the sides narrowing slightly to distinctly forwards; posterior margin of the head round or weakly trilobed. Frontal tube short, the opening clearly visible in dorsal view, or slightly prominent and facing forwards. Labrum short, length and width subequal; lateral corners obtuse-angled; midlobe short. Antenna 20 or 21 segments. Postmentum constricted near the middle. Mandibles curved, moderately elongate, the tip slightly hooked; the first marginal tooth of the left mandible small, projecting only slightly beyond the apical cutting edge; the first marginal tooth of the right mandible reduced or vestigial; the apical cutting edge of the left mandible distinctly S-shaped, forming a notch before M1; the apical cutting edge of the right mandible straight, curved only at the tip. Anterior margin of the pronotum concave.

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Large worker: head capsule densely covered with numerous short, straight setae; postclypeus with many short setae; fontanelle large, slightly triangular. Antenna 20 or 21 segments. Thoracic spines moderately developed. Mandibles similar to those of S. grandis, the molar plate wide.
